description: S457 3a — a bare call handler does not bind `event`: `oninput=setV(event.target.value)` is E-EVENT-UNBOUND, pointing at `oninput=${(e) => setV(e.target.value)}`.
rationale: §5.2 "Handler values do not bind `event`" (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S457 "1a 2a 3a 4a 5 dd it 6a", item 3): "A reference to `event` in such a value that no binding of the author's resolves … SHALL be compile error E-EVENT-UNBOUND".
